STRICT RULE: Absolutely no music, only diegetic sounds.
Realism cinematic, real skin with pores and small marks, natural eyes, people and set lit only by this place's named sources: the low golden sun behind right, backlighting the maize leaves and rimming the hair, the spaces between the rows in soft shadow; warm natural colour with saturated, believable greens; dust drifting in the air.
Framed on the rule of thirds, with a light anamorphic lens character: softly oval out-of-focus highlights in the background, and a fine 35mm film grain.
Image reference 1 (location Maize field): the Maize field 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 2 (character Devendra): Devendra, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 3 (character Suman): Suman, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 4 (character The boy): The boy, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 5 (prop Spacecraft): the Spacecraft 100% as in the reference.
Continuity: Devendra is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; Suman is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; The boy is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage.
In frame only: Devendra, Suman and the boy. The edge of the maize field, the rows running away from the lens, the craft half-buried thirty steps in at the end of the flattened trail, far. Devendra stands one step ahead of Suman toward the field, screen left, middle; Suman kneels at the field's edge, screen centre, near; the boy stands before her at arm's length with his back to the trail. Eyelines never at the camera.
Opening: Devendra standing one step ahead of Suman with his eyes on the craft; Suman kneeling with her eyes along the trail; the boy standing before her with his hand in hers.
Devendra speaks aloud 1 time between 1.8s and 2.6s and never again; silent before 1.8s and from 2.6s to the end.
Suman and the boy never speak in this clip.
Devendra is out to make Suman see the craft; once she looks he holds his ground before it, with resilience.
Suman is out to take in what Devendra sees; once she has seen the hatch she looks back down to the child, with perseverance.
The boy is out to keep hold of Suman; once her eyes come down to him he holds her hand with both of his, with persistence.
Pace: slow and hushed, one beat where his line lands; every shot opens in motion and the last one pushes in slowly.
S1 0.0-1.6s · medium, from the craft side at waist height looking back at the three, slightly low, static · Devendra stands near centre with his eyes down and left of the lens on the hatch, his hands open at his sides; Suman kneeling with the boy standing before her in the middle distance behind him, hand in hand; maize around them.
S2 1.6-4.2s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from Suman's side, slightly low, slow push-in · his eyes hold on the craft off right of the lens, his throat moving as his voice begins at 1.8s and ends at 2.6s, his hands still at his sides; the dark hull soft behind him.
S3 4.2-6.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly high, handheld · Suman's eyes rest on the open hatch off left of the lens, dust drifting between them; the boy's hair at the bottom edge of the frame, pale maize behind her.
S4 6.0-7.4s · insert, the hands from above, static · the boy's second hand comes in from the left and closes over Suman's hand so both his small hands wrap around hers; the dry earth below.
S5 7.4-9.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the craft side, slightly high, static · Suman's eyes drop from the hatch down to the boy below the bottom edge of the frame, her plait over her shoulder; maize soft behind her.
S6 9.0-10.4s · close, cut at the collarbones, from Suman's side, slightly high, static · the boy's look passing right of the lens up at Suman, his two hands around hers at the bottom of the frame; the craft's dark shape soft in the field behind him.
S7 10.4-13.0s · extreme_close, brows to lips, from the front, eye level, slow push-in · her eyes on the boy low and right of the lens, her lips closed, dust drifting past her face, a single soft metallic tick from the cooling hull at 12.2s; only pale maize behind her.
All speech is in Hindi. Only the words inside double quotation marks are ever spoken aloud; every voice direction and every other word of this text stays silent.
S2 (1.8-2.6s) Devendra to Suman, a man's voice of about 36, a dry quiet baritone, a central Indian Hindi accent, steady and low, barely above a whisper: "सुमन…"
No speech in S1, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7.
Restrictions:
- No music of any kind: no score, no soundtrack, no background music, no melody, no drone, no pad, no sting, no swell.
- No added sound effects: no whoosh, no boom, no impact hit, no riser.
- Only diegetic sound: the characters' voices and the natural sounds of this place.
- No words but the quoted lines, each only inside its own Audio window; outside them no one on screen speaks, whispers or mouths a word.
